department: Department of Physics, College of Science and Technology

deadline.value: No separate Physics PhD deadline is published; SGSR's Fall international F-1 applicant deadline is February 15, 2027 (general domestic regular deadline July 1; SGSR urges applying in the fall of senior year so funding evaluations begin in January).
deadline.quote: Fall (August to December) | April 1 | July 1 | February 15

also.quote: Students are urged to apply in the fall of their senior year since this allows for the evaluation and award processes to begin by January of each academic year.

gre_subject.value: Neither the Department of Physics PhD page nor SGSR states whether the GRE Physics Subject Test is required or optional (the department's Curriculum Course Map link to catalog.famu.edu failed TLS verification).

supervisor.value: The Physics PhD and SGSR pages do not state whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The Department of Physics states that graduate student support including tuition support is available for qualified students; SGSR notes tuition and assistantship awards are competitive, merit-based, and not guaranteed yearly.
funding.quote: Undergraduate and graduate student support, including tuition support, is available for qualified students.

also.quote: Tuition and assistantship awards are competitive and merit-based, and the School/College will award only a selected number of graduate students each Academic Semester. Funding is not guaranteed yearly

entry_route.value: Under FAMU's university-wide graduate admission rules, applicants may enter with a bachelor's degree (3.0+ GPA in the last 60 credit hours) or a related graduate degree (3.0+ GPA).
entry_route.quote: Hold a baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution of higher education and have earned a Grade Point Average (GPA) of 3.0 or higher in the last sixty (60) credit hours of undergraduate work taken while enrolled as an upper-division student working towards a bachelor’s degree, or | Hold a graduate degree in a related field from an accredited institution of higher learning with a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or better.

notes: Ph.D. in Physics requires GRE General (university rule; SGSR cites 300 combined minimum). Degree map link on catalog.famu.edu failed TLS verification.
